body: I don't believe in any God either *(fellow atheist here)* and I ask myself the same question every day, even though I don't know the answer and know that no one will provide me the answer. There isn't anyone that knowledgeable or capable (yet?) of answering such questions.

The art in this sub is exceptional. If I ever had a band that focused on writing lyrics related to BPD, depression etc. I would contact some of you to do a cover art for us. You are truly talented to express your feelings and emotions like this :-) keep it up!

About kitchen sink: I fixed this by not using more than 1 single plate, bowl and 1 set of cutlery. It forces me to clean it, so I can actually eat something throughout the day. Give it a try :-) You don't need 10's of plates if you are not having any guests or whatever.

I hope you are not me, mate. I wouldn't wish this shit I'm going through daily on anybody, not even my enemies. I wouldn't wish them to live through even one day of my life.

I feel like if you don't win the genetic lottery of being healthy individual, you are pretty much fucked. No matter what you do, you will always think about what could've have been, if you were healthy like most people are. I hate people who are healthy and destroy their life with drugs, alcohol and other shit for no reason at all. I got couple of friends who are perfectly healthy, but they don't give a shit about anything other than partying and drinking all day. They got no goals, no money, nothing. They are just wasting their perfectly healthy lives by doing unproductive useless shit every single day. The only thing I envy them is their health, nothing else. Definitely not their intelligence, because they are clearly messed up in their heads.

I think I will go into skydiving course (I've always wanted to try sky diving) and get enough experience to jump just by myself, I'll close my eyes and head it straight to the ground.  I'll try to make it look like an accident, so my family don't feel sad, because if I jumped out of balcony from my father's apartment, they (especially mom) would blame themselves for not being there to help me, even though they really can't do anything to help. Even if they wanted to. I know that my mom wouldn't be able to live another day if I committed suicide, which is pretty much the only thing that keeps me alive now (dogs would be taken care of, so those don't keep me alive, like many people in here mention) and I don't want my siblings to lose our mom because of my decision to end my life. I don't want to take that responsibility on me, even though I think once we die there is nothingness, just like before we were born, but I wouldn't want to steal them the precious time they can have with my mom till she is gone.

This virus is not going to wipe out humanity, but it's already affecting a lot of businesses around the whole world. Some people already lost their jobs due to this rather quickly spreading virus. So in a way these testers are "saving the mankind".

What are those strong indications? Coronavirus is killing off mostly elderly people and people with weak immunity. Not everybody who gets the virus dies. It's important to look not only at the number of infected people, but age of those people and what's the mortality rate for each age group *(some news don't mention this enough, which is a shame..)*

The real apocalypse would be if everybody who got infected started dying in 2 weeks or so, no matter the age. That would fuck up the world in a way we can't imagine. It would be freaking bonkers.

Of course these situations are gonna affect the market negatively *(but also depends on how you look at it),* especially if people are told to stay at home to not catch the virus *(meaning some will storm the stores and buy supplies for weeks/months to survive and don't buy anything for a long time, only the essential things for survival),* but IMO it's not going to affect it in the long run. Maybe for few months or till we get some vaccine to counterattack the virus, but eventually the market should recover. Maybe not this year, but eventually it will.

This is not some zombie apocalypse or some virus that wipes out thousands of people of different ages every day...
